name: ibanforge
description: Pre-payout screening for AI agents — vet a counterparty IBAN before you send funds: IBAN validation, BIC/SWIFT lookup, Swiss BC-Nummer clearing (full SIX BankMaster payment-rail participation + QR-IID — the deepest Swiss clearing data in any public API), EMI/vIBAN classification, SEPA + VoP reachability and sanctions + risk scoring.

tools.name: validate_iban
tools.description: Validate one IBAN and enrich it: BIC/SWIFT, country, EMI/vIBAN issuer class, SEPA + VoP reachability, risk indicators, and Swiss bc_nummer for CH/LI. Cost: $0.005 USDC.

tools.name: batch_validate_iban
tools.description: Validate up to 100 IBANs in one call. Cost: $0.002 USDC per IBAN (e.g. 100 IBANs = $0.20).

tools.name: lookup_bic
tools.description: Resolve a BIC/SWIFT code into bank name, country, city and LEI. Backed by 121k+ BIC entries, refreshed monthly. Cost: $0.003 USDC.

bic.description: BIC code (8 or 11 characters, e.g., UBSWCHZH80A)

tools.name: lookup_ch_clearing
tools.description: Resolve a Swiss BC-Nummer / IID into institution name, type, address, full payment-rail participation (SIC, euroSIC, CHF instant, LSV+/BDD) and QR-IID — the deepest Swiss clearing data in any public API (1,100+ SIX BankMaster entries). Cost: $0.003 USDC.

iid.description: Swiss IID / BC-Nummer (1-5 digits, e.g., 230 for UBS Switzerland)

tools.name: check_compliance
tools.description: Pre-flight compliance triage on an IBAN: bank-BIC-level sanctions screening (OFAC, EU) + FATF jurisdiction flag + SEPA Instant reachability + VoP (EU 2024/886) participant + risk score 0-100. No UN or SECO list is screened. Informational, not a regulated AML/CFT product. Cost: $0.02 USDC.
